Aster is the single canonical product continuing Astherus/ApolloX, not three admissions. This target is own BNB Chain asUSDF Earn staking, not USDF issuer/admin minting, the Aster deposit bridge, derivatives account, aggregator, or third-party wrapper. Current docs identify this exact asUSDF minting contract and the BNB claim flow.

EIP1967 staking proxy currently binds implementation 0x29f30635431426363D130aa163816Ead1101662f; proxy source-service match is match, implementation exact_match. Immutable USDF 0x5a110fc00474038f6c02e89c707d638602ea44b5, asUSDF 0x917af46b3c3c6e1bb7286b9f59637fb7c65851fb and withdrawal vault 0xad4836bbf3671ebd4f2e1f49119c1184655e47ca match read-only responses. Vault currently binds 0x1A63fDbD396465A319b7Aea1dD9c0BF0A339BF89. Both proxies remain timelock-upgradeable, role-managed and independently pausable; identities are point-in-time, not persistent runtime attestations.

deposit pulls USDF from msg.sender into the staking proxy using allowance to that proxy; actual balance delta is used to floor-mint asUSDF to msg.sender at the pre-transfer exchange price. No arbitrary receiver, permit, opaque bytes or dynamic call target exists. Deposit requires positive amount, enabled deposits, unpaused staking and positive minted shares. Underlying/token role/transfer pauses can independently fail.

Exchange price is floor((USDF balance minus unvested rewards)*1e18/asUSDF total supply), with 1e18 fallback when supply or net balance is zero. Authorized reward distribution vests linearly over immutable 28800 seconds (8 hours); this is NOT a withdrawal waiting period. Prices and rounding can change; no user minimum shares/output, deadline or rate guarantee is present.

requestWithdraw fixes floor(asUSDF amount*current price/1e18) USDF payout, transfers that USDF to the fixed withdrawal vault, pulls caller asUSDF using allowance to the staking proxy, then burns it atomically. It records caller as receipt, current time/price and claimable=false. This is a caller-owned queue, not immediate redemption, and no cancellation method is exposed. Any later yield does not increase this fixed request payout.

claimWithdraw accepts request numbers but enforces recorded receipt == msg.sender, positive payout and claimable. It deletes the request and asks the fixed vault to transfer USDF only to msg.sender; batch failure reverts atomically, including duplicate/unavailable IDs. Claim needs staking and vault unpaused, withdrawals enabled, staking TRANSFER_ROLE at the vault and vault cash. These current role/cash conditions are not attested.

BOT_ROLE must explicitly mark withdrawal requests claimable; source has no automatic elapsed-time claim entitlement or hardcoded queue deadline. Docs describe T+1 hour (about 2 hours), but this is operational guidance, not guaranteed source-enforced timing. Requests can remain unclaimable if processing is delayed. Emergency withdrawal/whitelist operations are not admitted.

Selected staking source charges no mint/request/claim protocol fee and docs say asUSDF mint/withdraw no fees; gas is separate. USDF-to-USDT issuer redemption is a different product (documented fee/delay) and is not admitted. No yield, USDF backing/redemption or stable peg assurance is made.

USDF economic strategy relies on custodial/off-chain delta-neutral positions and funding fees, documented with Ceffu custody. Staking share accounting does not isolate this custody, strategy, centralized exchange, oracle or governance risk. No caller KYC/whitelist check appears on ordinary selected entrypoints, but app eligibility/jurisdiction and token restrictions remain.

devdoc.details: This contract implements an upgradeable proxy. It is upgradeable because calls are delegated to an implementation address that can be changed. This address is stored in storage in the location specified by https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-1967[EIP1967], so that it doesn't conflict with the storage layout of the implementation behind the proxy.

constructor.details: Initializes the upgradeable proxy with an initial implementation specified by `_logic`. If `_data` is nonempty, it's used as data in a delegate call to `_logic`. This will typically be an encoded function call, and allows initializating the storage of the proxy like a Solidity constructor.
